title: An Invoices import file with an unknown column name is rejected
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions, including Settings → Data Import) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A16.csv) is made from the Invoices import template with one Labor row for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A16 Fleet), invoice number {Invoice-number-A} (for example ZZWW-A16-1), *Line Title value (for example Replace tie rod) and Line Description value (for example excessive play); but its 16th header reads "*Line Name" instead of "*Line Title".
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings and, under Data Import, click Invoices.
  2. Upload {File-A} and start the import.
  3. Read the import result message.
  4. Search the imported invoices for {Invoice-number-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the file is rejected with "Invalid file headers provided!".
  • Step 4: no invoice {Invoice-number-A} was imported.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S4-N1, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-018; Product rewording of S4-N1, 24 Sep 2026 (tech plan clarifications); Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).
